title: Run a batch of inputs
summary: batch applies a runnable to several inputs and returns their results in input order. It can make repeated use easier to express.
introduction: batch applies a runnable to several inputs and returns their results in input order. It can make repeated use easier to express. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain run a batch of inputs
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: batch applies a runnable to several inputs and returns their results in input order. It can make repeated use easier to express.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda
length = RunnableLambda(len)
print(length.batch(["Moon", "Sun", "Ocean"]))
blocks.title: Run a batch of inputs

blocks.text: The output is [4, 3, 5]. Each string is measured separately. The results correspond to Moon, Sun and Ocean in that order.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A batch may run steps concurrently; avoid local functions that depend on a shared changing counter.
